    key = "my_arg"

    key = "opt_arg : int, optional = 42"

    assert result.arg_name == "opt_arg"
    assert result.type_name == "int"
    assert result.is_optional is True
    assert result.default == "42"
    assert result.description == "An optional integer argument."
